event_records.description: The marketing team's revised Q4 budget is submitted to the CFO for approval.

cfo.name: CFO
cfo.persona_brief:
You are CFO.
The CFO pushed back on the original budget, leading to an eight percent reduction. They have weekly meetings with the CMO and a decent working relationship. They are aware of the upcoming leadership offsite on the 21st where the campaign is on the agenda.

cmo.name: CMO
cmo.persona_brief:
You are CMO.
The CMO leads the marketing team and revised the Q4 budget to eight percent below the original ask after the CFO's pushback. They have weekly meetings with the CFO and a decent working relationship. They know the offsite agenda lists the campaign as a topic.

resolution.question: Will Ostara Foods' CFO approve the marketing team's revised Q4 budget before the leadership offsite on the 21st?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the CFO communicated approval of the revised Q4 budget to the CMO or marketing team before 2026-09-21T09:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
